name: 经常性服务 (7GA)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item covers the creation of maintenance plans in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, as well as scheduling and service order creation. Maintenance plans can be set up to release the service order automatically when you create the service order or to let the user release the order manually afterwards. Service order items are copied from the service order templates that are assigned to maintenance items in the maintenance plan.

The Service Quotation and Order Management (Scope item 41Z) is the follow-on process for further processing of the service order, such as planning, releasing, time and material confirmation, billing, and order completion.

The completion date is updated automatically in the maintenance plan either upon completion of service order or manually by the user. Updating the measuring counter reading is an optional step during confirmation.

Key Process Flow

  • Create maintenance plan
  • Schedule maintenance plan (individual/mass)
  • Select service order template
  • Assign service contract items (optional)
  • Plan and schedule maintenance plan
  • Create related service quotation or service order

Business Benefits

  • Provide capabilities for regular maintenance planning and scheduling of service
  • Cover single cycle time / counter-based and multicounter plans
  • Support individual scheduling and mass scheduling via background jobs to trigger service orders
  • Provide capabilities for planning and executing of services
  • Automatic time-sheet and expense postings based on confirmation
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目涵盖在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中创建维护计划，以及计划和服务订单创建。可以设置维护计划，以便在创建服务订单时自动下达服务订单，或者让用户之后手动下达订单。从服务订单模板复制服务订单项目，这些模板分配到维护计划中的维护项目。

服务报价和订单管理（范围项目 41Z）是进一步处理服务订单的后续流程，例如计划、审批、时间和物料确认、开票和订单完成。

完成服务订单后，完成日期将在维护计划中自动更新，也可以由用户手动更新。在确认期间更新测量计数器读数是可选步骤。

关键流程流

  • 创建维护计划
  • 计划维护计划（单独/批量）
  • 选择服务订单模板
  • 分配服务合同项目（可选）
  • 计划和安排维护计划
  • 创建相关服务报价或服务订单

业务优势

  • 提供定期维护计划和服务安排功能。
  • 涵盖单个周期时间/基于计数器和多计数器计划
  • 通过后台作业支持单个计划和批量计划，以触发服务订单
  • 提供计划和执行服务的功能
  • 基于确认的自动时间表和费用过账
